paper_metadata.title: Influence of the minor alloying on microstructure and mechanical properties of Zr-Nb alloy

evidence.quote: This study investigates the influence of minor alloying elements on the phase stability, microstructure, and mechanical properties of Zr-Nb alloys through integrated first-principles calculations and experimental approaches.

mechanisms.name: β phase stabilization by Mo doping

evidence.quote: Special quasirandom structure (SQS) modeling revealed that Mo doping significantly can stabilize the β phase by inducing strong electron interactions with the Zr/Nb matrix, whereas V, Ta, and Hf additions failed to achieve comparable stabilization.
